verdicts.why: Episode 11 is all in New York: Rawlins's men go after Sarah and Zach, and Castle fights at the power station. The Cerberus backstory is told in episode 3, and the family was killed at the Central Park carousel.
In S.O.S. Part One (#43) Raina tells Jiaying she will reveal who really started the war, Jiaying stabs her at Afterlife, and Skye sees it and turns on her.
In After, Before (#131) May and Yo-Yo visit Jiaying at Afterlife. Nathaniel recruits Kora and takes over Afterlife, and Jiaying and Gordon flee with them.
Lamentis takes place at TVA headquarters and then on 2077 Lamentis-1. Nothing happens in Alabama.
In The Nexus Event, B-15 takes Sylvie back to 2050 Roxxcart. Sylvie probes her mind and B-15 remembers her past life. The fandom page lists Alabama > Haven Hills > Roxxcart Mall.
In The Tomb, Ammit's tomb is at a desert campsite in Egypt, and it ends with the psychiatric hospital. The Alps appear only in episode 1.

The sea battle is at the vessel, but Shuri traps Namor in a fighter aircraft. They crash on a desert beach, and that is where she defeats him and he yields, so the sparing does not happen at the ship.
In Team Thor: Part 1, Thor returns to Earth in Australia and becomes the roommate of the office worker Darryl Jacobson.
Episode 53 is Nightcrawler. Asteroid M is the two-part Sanctuary (#48 and #49), and #49 is where Cortez takes control and fires the missiles. Using #49 keeps the entry from spoiling a later episode.
The fandom location list for Tolerance Is Extinction Part 1 (#8) has Genosha only as Mentioned. Bastion is revealed in #7.
The massacre is in #5 and the blackout is in #8. The #9 location list has Genosha only as Mentioned, and the action is at Asteroid M, Muir Island and the Galapagos.
Cable helps Gambit escape Genosha in #7 (Slave Island). In #9 (The Cure), Cable tracks Adler to Muir Island, and the fandom list has Genosha only as Mentioned.
The blackout strikes in #8, and Xavier restores the power in #10. The Silver Samurai's page says he sees both from Japan, so only the power coming back belongs to #10.
The #8 location list has Tokyo (cameo), and the Silver Samurai's page says he sees Magneto shut off the world's power from Japan in #8.

Proteus escapes Muir Island in Part I (#56), and the Edinburgh rampage and its end are in Part II (#57). Moving the entry to #56 with the Edinburgh ending still in it would spoil #57, so that half is dropped.
value: Moira MacTaggert's son Proteus breaks out of her island lab, and she calls on the X-Men for help.

verdicts.why: In The Cure, Xavier asks Moira at the Muir Island Research Center to review Adler's work and she says she cannot. Rogue comes to the island for the cure, and Cable hunts Adler there.
Same #9 entry as item 15, so add it only once. The scene with Moira and Xavier takes place at the Muir Island Research Center.
In Phoenix Saga Part III (#31), Juggernaut and Black Tom attack Muir Island, where Xavier is recovering in Moira's care, and take Lilandra to Cassidy Keep.
Gambit returning to New Orleans, brainwashing his friends and family and kidnapping Rogue happens in The Dead Man's Hand, which is season 2 episode 8 (#18 overall).
The Berlin prison break is in episode 3 (Power Broker). Episode 4 takes place in Riga, Latvia, and Berlin appears in it only as flashback footage.
In Science/Fiction, Loki goes to Sylvie in 1982 Broxton. She refuses to join him, then changes her mind when her timeline is spaghettified. Broxton is in the episode's location list.
Smoke & Mirrors (S2E4, #12) flashes back to the 1920s in Broxton, Oklahoma. There young Agnes Cully fixes a radio and her mother tells her that her looks will serve her better.
Heart of the TVA takes place at the Citadel at the End of Time and the TVA. Its location list has Chicago only as Mentioned.

In Karma's a Glitch, Riri makes peace with Ronnie, N.A.T.A.L.I.E. and Xavier and builds a new suit in Gary's garage with Zelma and Landon, and Zelma powers it with magic. The story is set at Riri's Chicago home.
Ronnie's reconciliation in #5 is the same event as the lead:1 entry, and her turning to Madeline is in #4 (lead:4). Per the owner's rule, one event gets one entry.
Zelma powering the new suit with magic in #5 is already in the lead:1 entry.

In Bad Magic, the biomesh is traced to Zeke, who is arrested and turns against Riri. Ronnie seeks help from Madeline Stanton, and the Stantons find the cloak fragment comes from a dark dimension. The story is set in Chicago.
Madeline examining the cloak fragment in #4 is already in the lead:4 entry.
Landon helping build the suit in Gary's garage in #5 is already in the lead:1 entry.

In Theseus (#2), Vision finds Tommy at Saint Mabyn's Psychiatric Sanitarium, where Paladin's men have killed the staff, and escapes with him. Fandom places the sanitarium in England, and only #1 is set at the Edinburgh pub.
In No Strings (#1), Vision works at Fiona Guthrie's pub in Edinburgh, and Paladin's mercenaries attack it to capture him, killing Fiona in the crossfire.
Randolph says on screen he saw the carving in a castle in Gloucestershire, England, and in Closure the trace puts it in the southwest of England. The current pin is in Warwickshire.
In Maveth (#54), Mack, Morse and Hunter secure the castle's portal room. Fitz and Coulson return through it, and Hive secretly comes back too, inhabiting Ward's body.

In Purpose in the Machine (#46), Randolph takes the team to the castle and its machine. Daisy opens the portal, and Fitz goes through and brings Simmons back. Her being taken and her time on Maveth happen elsewhere.
